## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 4-juan Late-Míng wild-edible-plants reference by Bào Shān, extending the *Jiù huāng běn cǎo* ([KR3d0006](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3d/KR3d0006)) tradition of Zhū Sù. Composition: bracketed to ca. 1622 (the latest reasonable Late-Míng dating). The frontmatter brackets to 1622–1622.

**Abstract**

The *Yě cài bó lù* is one of the principal Late-Míng applied-botanical works in the famine-relief edible-plants tradition. The bibliographic record: *Míng shǐ yìwén zhì*; SKQS *Zǐbù — Nóngjiā lèi*.
